    try:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
        _record("pick_up_tips", True, "tip picked from tip_rack_50ul['A1']")
    except Exception as e:
        _record("pick_up_tips", False, str(e))

    if results["pick_up_tips"][0]:

            await lh.aspirate(source["A1"], vols=[50])
            _record("aspirate", True, "50uL from source_plate['A1'] (fits 50uL tip)")

            _record("aspirate", False, str(e))
    else:
        _record("aspirate", False, "SKIPPED: no tips on pipette")

    if results["aspirate"][0]:
        try:
            await lh.dispense(dest["A1"], vols=[50])
            _record("dispense", True, "50uL into destination_plate['A1']")
        except Exception as e:
            _record("dispense", False, str(e))
    else:
        _record("dispense", False, "SKIPPED: aspirate did not pass")

    if results["pick_up_tips"][0] and results["aspirate"][0]:
        try:
            await lh.aspirate(source["B1"], vols=[50])
            await lh.mix(dest["B1"], vols=[30], repeats=3)
            _record("mix", True, "3x 30uL mix in destination_plate['B1']")
        except Exception as e:

    if results["pick_up_tips"][0]:

            _record("drop_tips", True, "tips returned to tip_rack_50ul['A2']")
        except Exception as e:
            _record("drop_tips", False, str(e))
    else:
        _record("drop_tips", False, "SKIPPED: no tips on pipette")

    total = len(results)
    n_passed = sum(1 for ok, _ in results.values() if ok)
    n_failed = total - n_passed

    else:
